doc:
Note that this weapon requires a bullet with a positive maxRange.
Rotation must be set to true. Fixed repair points are not supported.

display.doc: whether weapon should appear in the stats of a unit with this weapon

mirror.doc: whether to create a flipped copy of this weapon upon initialization. default: true

flipSprite.doc: whether to flip the weapon's sprite when rendering. internal use only - do not set!

alternate.doc: whether to shoot the weapons in different arms one after another, rather than all at once; only valid when mirror = true

rotate.doc: whether to rotate toward the target independently of unit

showStatSprite.doc: Whether to show the sprite of the weapon in the database.

baseRotation.doc: rotation at which this weapon starts at.

top.doc: whether to draw the outline on top.

continuous.doc: whether to hold the bullet in place while firing; it will still require reload.

alwaysContinuous.doc: whether this weapon uses continuous fire without reloading; implies continuous = true

aimChangeSpeed.doc: Speed at which the turret can change its bullet "aim" distance. This is only used for point laser bullets.

controllable.doc: whether this weapon can be aimed manually by players

aiControllable.doc: whether this weapon can be automatically aimed by the unit

alwaysShooting.doc: whether this weapon is always shooting, regardless of targets ore cone

autoTarget.doc: whether to automatically target relevant units in update(); only works when controllable = false.

predictTarget.doc: whether to perform target trajectory prediction

useAttackRange.doc: if true, this weapon is used for attack range calculations

rotateSpeed.doc: rotation speed of weapon when rotation is enabled, in degrees/t

inaccuracy.doc: inaccuracy of degrees of each shot

shake.doc: intensity and duration of each shot's screen shake

recoils.doc: Number of additional counters for recoil.

recoilTime.doc: time taken for weapon to return to starting position in ticks. uses reload time by default

recoilPow.doc: power curve applied to visual recoil

cooldownTime.doc: ticks to cool down the heat region

shootX.doc: projectile/effect offsets from center of weapon

shootY.doc: projectile/effect offsets from center of weapon

x.doc: offsets of weapon position on unit

y.doc: offsets of weapon position on unit

xRand.doc: Random spread on the X/Y axis.

yRand.doc: Random spread on the X/Y axis.

shadow.doc: radius of shadow drawn under the weapon; <0 to disable

velocityRnd.doc: fraction of velocity that is random

extraVelocity.doc: extra velocity that is added as a fraction

shootCone.doc: The half-radius of the cone in which shooting will start.

rotationLimit.doc: Cone in which the weapon can rotate relative to its mount.

minWarmup.doc: minimum weapon warmup before firing (this is not linear, do NOT use 1!)

shootWarmupSpeed.doc: lerp speed for shoot warmup, only used for parts

smoothReloadSpeed.doc: lerp speed for shoot warmup, only used for parts

linearWarmup.doc: If true, shoot warmup is linear instead of a curve.

ignoreRotation.doc: whether shooter rotation is ignored when shooting.

noAttack.doc: If true, this weapon cannot be used to attack targets.

minShootVelocity.doc: min velocity required for this weapon to shoot

parentizeEffects.doc: should the shoot effects follow the unit (effects need followParent set to true for this to work)

otherSide.doc: internal value used for alternation - do not change!

layerOffset.doc: draw Z offset relative to the default value

initialShootSound.doc: sound used when this weapon first fires; for continuous weapons only

chargeSound.doc: sound used for weapons that have a delay

heatRegion.doc: heat region, must be same size as region (optional)

cellRegion.doc: cell region, must be same size as region (optional)

outlineRegion.doc: outline region to display if top is false

mountType.doc: type of weapon mount to be used

shootOnDeath.doc: whether this weapon should fire when its owner dies

shootOnDeathEffect.doc: If not null and shootOnDeath == true, overrides the weapon's shoot effect only when its owner dies.
